outlook.title: Offshore of Southwestern Mexico
outlook.summary: An area of low pressure could form well offshore of Mexico over the weekend. Gradual development is possible early next week as the system moves west-northwestward at 10 to 15 mph, and is likely to remain well offshore of Mexico.
